name: eMACS J0043.1-1129 (Hubble)
blurb: eMACS J0043.1-1129, a massive, X-ray-luminous galaxy cluster, seen by Hubble.
label: emacsj004311129-hubble
story: A great swarm of galaxies, picked out from the whole sky by its brilliant X-ray glow. Hubble surveyed clusters like this one to find the most powerful natural lenses in the distant universe.

claims.text: eMACS J0043.1-1129 is a highly X-ray-luminous galaxy cluster from the extended Massive Cluster Survey
Target of a Hubble snapshot survey of the most massive clusters, aimed at finding powerful gravitational lenses
eMACS is an X-ray selected survey based on the ROSAT All-Sky Survey
